title: Ukraine Launches Massive Drone Strikes on Russian Facilities; Russian Strikes Cut Power in Ukraine
detail: An aggregated report dated Nov 1 says Kyiv launched massive drone strikes on Russian facilities, and Moscow reported a drone attack on Nizhny Novgorod. Russian strikes meanwhile cut power in parts of Ukraine. Specific targets, damage and casualty figures were not available in the aggregated summary.

title: Ukraine Says Russia Suffered Record Monthly Combat Losses in October
detail: Ukrainian figures cited in aggregated reports say Russia lost 54,400 personnel in October, a record monthly total, bringing cumulative Russian casualties to about 2.1 million since the full-scale invasion began. These are Ukrainian claims and are not independently verified; Russia does not publish comparable figures.

title: Ukrainians Receive Chemical and Nuclear Risk Alerts; Authorities Blame Hackers
detail: Residents of Ukraine received mobile alerts warning of chemical and nuclear risk on Nov 1. Authorities attributed the messages to a hacker action rather than a real threat, per Brazilian outlet G1. Details of the intrusion and the perpetrators were not available.
